source.title: Tribeca Pediatrics is personalizing the patient experience at scale

source_facts.fact: EHR integration supports a more complete patient view across multiple clinics.
Referral work includes sending information to specialists and tracking incomplete referrals.
Staff follow up with external providers for referral results.
A parent portal supports communication, appointments, result follow-up, and billing.
Portal updates can be reflected in the EHR.
Automated communication covers reminders and post-visit follow-up.

validation_extensions.scenario: A synthetic patient has a unified authorized view while unrelated clinic users remain denied.
Repeated referral sends create one effective dispatch plus an audit trail of attempts.
Acknowledgement and result deadlines schedule distinct reminders and cancel future reminders after completion.
Early and duplicate synthetic result events preserve monotonic state and raw event evidence.
Expired guardian authorization blocks result access; break-glass access records reason and expiry.
A remote EHR write followed by local timeout reconciles without duplicate clinical results.

synthetic_data_policy: Use fictional patients, guardians, clinics, appointments, referral reasons, results, and bills; no real PII, PHI, images, or provider records.
